items.summary: Scammers are pasting fake QR code stickers over the real ones on parking

items.title: One USB stick for every ISO — Ventoy boots them all free without reformatting
items.summary: Ventoy is free at ventoy.net — install it on a USB drive, copy as many ISO files as you want (Windows, Linux, rescue disks), and boot into a clean menu to pick which one to run. No reformatting between ISOs.

items.title: Windows has a free remote help tool built in — Quick Assist connects you safely
items.summary: Quick Assist is built into Windows 11 — press Start, type Quick Assist, and open it to get a 6-digit code for someone you trust to help you remotely. No download, no account, no third-party tool.

items.title: Free portable tool stops Windows tracking cold — O&O ShutUp10++ puts every privacy switch in one window
items.summary: O&O ShutUp10++ is free at oo-software.com — download the portable version, run it, and click "Apply recommended settings" to block Windows telemetry, data collection, and advertising IDs in one click.

items.title: Stop struggling with the Snipping Tool — ShareX is the free screenshot and screen recorder that does it all
items.summary: ShareX is free at getsharex.com or the Microsoft Store — install it, press Print Screen, and capture any region, window, scrolling page, or screen recording with annotations, arrows, and text in seconds.

items.title: Stop paying for Microsoft Office — LibreOffice is the free alternative that opens every file
items.summary: LibreOffice is free at libreoffice.org — download the installer for Windows, Mac, or Linux and it opens Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without a subscription, no account, and no forced AI features.

items.title: Fake CAPTCHAs Tell You to Press Windows+R — Don't Do It
items.summary:
Scammers have built 186 fake AI websites that look like legitimate chatbot and image-generator tools. When you visit them, a pop-up appears that looks like a "verify you're human" check. It tells you to press Windows+R, paste a command, and hit Enter. Doing that runs harmful code on your computer.

Real verification checks never ask you to open the Run box or paste commands. If a website tells you to press Windows+R, type something, or run a command — close the tab immediately. Do not follow any keyboard instructions from a webpage.

The fake sites mimic popular AI tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, and Claude. Always go directly to the official website (openai.com, midjourney.com, anthropic.com) instead of clicking search results.

items.title: Chrome 157 Emergency Update Fixes Actively Exploited Zero-Day — Update at chrome://settings/help
items.summary: Google released Chrome the latest version on November 9 fixing nine security issues including an actively exploited zero-day (the vulnerability-2026-125350) in the XML component. Update manually: open Chrome's Settings → Help → About Google Chrome, let it check and download, then click Relaunch.

items.title: Clearwave Fiber Expands Lake City Network — Thousands Now Eligible for All-Fiber Internet at clearwavefiber.com
items.summary: Clearwave Fiber continues expanding its all-fiber network in Lake City, with several thousand residents now able to receive fiber internet service. Check availability at clearwavefiber.com. Fiber offers symmetrical speeds up to 5 Gbps with no data caps.

items.title: Router Security Alert: Thousands of Devices Compromised — Check Yours Now
items.summary:
Thousands of routers and network switches have been hijacked in recent weeks. 
Attackers are exploiting known flaws in Zyxel GS1900 switches and SonicWall 
VPN devices — nearly 1,000 Zyxel switches compromised worldwide, and SonicWall's 
SSL-VPN authentication bypass is being actively abused. CISA added six actively 
exploited vulnerabilities to its must-patch list on November 10, including 
flaws in Cisco BroadWorks and Barracuda email gateways.

What to do: Log into your router or switch admin page (usually 192.168.1.1 or 
192.168.0.1 in your web browser). Check for a firmware update and install it 
immediately. If your device is older than 5 years and no updates are available, 
replace it. Change the default admin password if you haven't already.

Why it matters: A compromised router...

items.title: CISA Adds Six Actively Exploited Vulnerabilities — Update Chrome, Outlook, and Barracuda Now
items.summary: CISA added six exploited vulnerabilities on November 10 affecting Google Chrome (CVE-2026-125350), Microsoft Outlook (CVE-2026-124194), Barracuda Email Security Gateway (CVE-2026-111560, CVE-2026-116606), Cisco BroadWorks (CVE-2026-20320), and Openwave Webtop (CVE-2026-111793). Update Chrome at `chrome://settings/help`, Outlook via Windows Update, and Barracuda appliances per vendor guidance.

items.title: **Headline:** Windows 11 October Update KB5127648 Breaks Wi-Fi and VPN — Here's the Temporary Fix
items.summary: If your Wi-Fi or VPN stopped authenticating after the October 13 update (KB5127648), this NTLMv1 restriction may be the cause. Windows Group Policy can restore access. Onyx technicians can check and resolve this for you — call (386) 755-7772 for help.
